ask._.vee: Yann Vee stepped off the supply cart at S-F10 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Yann Vee received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
Yann Vee left the work of a rifleman to become a sapper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.
Now serving as a sniper, Yann Vee discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
Yann Vee (Concord) and Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) met in the same shell hole at Calvary Farm during a raid. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
At Calvary Farm, Teodor Acakostic of the Hegemony and Yann Vee of the Concord traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.

A shouted challenge from Yann Vee (Concord) reached Gustav "Tin" Jul (Hegemony) at the Drowned Farm. The answer was lost beneath the guns. The challenge was not repeated. The Concord took Verdel Ridge, and the orders at S-F10 changed before the cheering ended. Yann Vee shouldered another load.
Dawn watch. Yann Vee put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Edmund Matteozrybak, badly wounded.

Yann Vee tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. A letter from home found Yann Vee before the night shift. Yann Vee folded it small and kept it close.

Yann Vee wrote a letter for Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy's mother, because Saint could not find the words. Saint signed it. After the loss of Hill 304, Yann Vee helped stack spare sandbags at S-F10. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F10 and grazed Yann Vee's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Arno Toastyy of the Hegemony (@totally.am.toastyy). Yann Vee fired at a movement across the wire at S-F10. The man went down: Edmund Somosmagios, gravely wounded. A letter from home found Yann Vee before the night shift. Yann Vee folded it small and kept it close.
Yann Vee no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Yann Vee fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios was grazed.
Yann Vee let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios was badly wounded.
its.samwade: "You're late," said the corporal when Ivo "Mud" Samwade arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
marcusho64: Day 8. The corporal put Dietrich Marcusho beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Dietrich Marcusho cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
odin21320: Lucien Odin introduced himself as a brewer from Coldwater. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
zer0_gundam: Rafael Gundam arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in R-C5 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
